title: Dallas Uptown Foodie Tour + Trolley by Food Tours of America
includes: 9 generous tastings at 5 handpicked Dallas restaurants — enough food for a meal, plus a sweet treat
Narrated Dallas foodie tour — discover the neighborhood and stories behind its historic streetcars
Behind-the-scenes Trolley Barn visit where the trolleys are restored & maintained (when available)
Ride a historic streetcar, not a reproduction, with remarkable stories of its own (when available)
Alcoholic beverages — available for purchase at select stops only (not included)
Guide gratuity — not included and always appreciated
Transportation to and from the tour, parking fees (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Historic McKinney Avenue trolley cars require climbing a few steep steps to enter and exit and are not wheelchair accessible. The trolley ride is a core part of the experience. If you have accessibility or mobility needs, please contact Food Tours of America before booking so we can provide additional information about the tour.

Guests should be comfortable walking approximately 1 mile, standing for portions of the 2.5-hour tour and climbing the steep steps required to board and exit the historic trolley. The experience includes both indoor and outdoor portions, so please dress for the weather and wear comfortable walking shoes.
policies: This is a walking tour through Dallas Uptown and includes approximately 1 mile of walking, sidewalks, curbs, street crossings and periods of standing.

At least 72 hours’ advance notice is required for dietary accommodations and menu substitutions. Please provide the name of each guest and their specific dietary restriction or food allergy when booking.
Booking within 72 hours? Please provide your dietary needs at the time of booking. We’ll do our best to accommodate last-minute requests, but some substitutions may be limited or unavailable.
All accommodations depend on each restaurant’s capabilities and cannot be guaranteed. Substitutions may differ from the standard tastings, and in some cases, fewer tastings may be available.

Severe or life-threatening food allergies: Our tours visit multiple independent restaurants, and we do not control their kitchens or the potential for cross-contact. For this reason, our tours may not be appropriate for guests with severe or life-threatening food allergies.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Taste your way through Uptown Dallas with 9 generous tastings at 5 restaurants, a ride aboard a real historic streetcar and a behind-the-scenes trolley barn experience. Come hungry for Moroccan-Lebanese, Thai, Southern comfort, Tex-Mex and Guatemalan flavors—with plenty of food for a meal.

Then climb aboard an authentic McKinney Avenue streetcar—not a reproduction—and hear the remarkable stories behind the vintage cars that still roll through Dallas, including Rosie, the fleet’s oldest car, which came all the way from Portugal.

When available, go behind the scenes at the McKinney Avenue Trolley Car Barn, a working facility not generally open to the public. See where the historic cars are restored and maintained and meet some of the people who keep them rolling.

Uptown Eats! launched in 2011 as Dallas’ original walking food tour, bringing together great food, neighborhood stories and a piece of Dallas history you can actually ride.
